title: Made a game with AI NPC and more
author: godwater8
selftext:
Made this within a month.

**Office Dream** is a narrative-driven life simulation where AI-powered coworkers can naturally chat with you, join AI-generated activities, and help create a unique story every playthrough.

More about this game: https://moondoor.games/

comments.author: Silver-Chipmunk7744
comments.body:
The primary issue is those voices sounds off  
Might be worth linking them to a decent speech API like fish, but i am guessing it would be expensive at scale.  
The other idea is an option to talk with voice.

User voice + decent sounding NPC voice probably makes it feel more natural.

replies.author: godwater8
replies.body: The NPC voice is from free TTS voice. There are voice input for player already.

replies.author: bingewavecinema
replies.body: If you want a quality game, you have to put money into somewhere

replies.author: godwater8
replies.body: It's still in demo stage, will do some testing first before put money in art/audio.

comments.author: bingewavecinema
comments.body: Dude, the voices, try with ElevenLabs, the current voices are cringy

replies.author: godwater8
replies.body: Thanks! Will try. Still making demo, flexible to update😉
